daily_lesson.explanation_en: When multiple technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, price vs. moving average, and trading volume — all point bullish at the same time, it's a stronger signal than any single indicator alone. Traders call this 'confluence,' and it helps filter out false signals from random price noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當多個技術指標（如RSI、MACD、股價相對移動平均線的位置，以及成交量）同時顯示看漲訊號時，這比單一指標更具說服力。交易者稱這種現象為「訊號匯聚」，有助於過濾隨機價格波動產生的假訊號。

market_education.summary_en: Broad equity indices advanced today, with growth-heavy NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, consistent with a risk-on tone across markets.
